_note: Example configuration for mklisten. Copy it, change the paths, and run: mklisten -c yourfile.json (add -t to only check it). Keys starting with _ are ignored.
_note_localnode: the L key in mkmon (sysop port) runs mk -L on this node number and returns to mkmon when it ends; use a number that is not one of the nodes above or of a port. Remove the line for no L key
_note_mailer: the binkp mailer (mkbink): mklisten makes its settings with mkbinkcfg from the BBS configuration (mkconfig: EchoMail > Mailer) and runs it while the mailer is switched on there; without this section nothing is run

ports._note: wss: stunnel accepts TLS (for example on 443) and connects here with protocol = proxy
QWK network systems and scripts: telnet in, Login: (QWK id), Password:, then QWK: D/U/B/Q (mk -Q; only users with the QWK Node flag)
sysop monitor: telnet to 127.0.0.1:2330 (from elsewhere use ssh -L 2330:127.0.0.1:2330), password in plain text or sha1:<hex digest>
